statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, I47.1, and I49.9 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
